duck_on_wake.description: Quieten the music while the assistant is listening.

duck_volume.description: How quiet to go while the assistant is listening. Low on purpose: the microphone hears the speakers, and music loud enough to hear is loud enough to be transcribed as speech.

pause_on_wake.description: Pause outright rather than quietening. Surer than any volume, at the cost of losing your place for a moment.
